workbook: 4. Appendix-II MYT Tariff Formats ARR FY 2026-27.xlsx
note: The Commission's capital funding, normative loan, return on equity and income tax for FY2026-27, and the interest on consumers' security deposit at the 5.50 % the order allows (6.50 % claimed), reproduced with the same draft rules (capital, MYT 2025, income tax) that reproduce NPCL's claim, fed the order's own figures (Tables 6-58, 6-67, 6-74, 6-76, read with page and quote) and checked against its printed approvals.  The loan rate is NPCL's (F25 I14, 9.8262 %): the order 'has considered the rate of interest as claimed by the Petitioner' (para 6.10.5, p.282) and prints it rounded (9.83 %), which alone would give 85.63, not 85.60.  Depreciation is the order's net approval (103.80), used as the loan repayment as Reg. 22.3 provides.
